changes.summary: Reject malformed/overflowing quest IDs before the native HandleQuestAutocomplete catalog/status/effect path;retain selected-player and native quest rules.
Reject malformed/overflowing quest IDs before the native HandleQuestAdd catalog/status/effect path;retain selected-player and native quest rules.
Reject malformed/overflowing quest IDs before the native HandleQuestRemove catalog/status/effect path;retain selected-player and native quest rules.
Reject malformed/overflowing quest IDs before the native HandleQuestComplete catalog/status/effect path;retain selected-player and native quest rules.
Reject malformed/overflowing quest IDs before the native HandleQuestReward catalog/status/effect path;retain selected-player and native quest rules.
Reject malformed/overflowing quest IDs before the native HandleQuestStatus catalog/status/effect path;retain selected-player and native quest rules.
Parse the complete signed level before online/offline changes;preserve the native110 cap,name-only reset and XP update;classify characters with unsigned input.
Parse a complete signed delta and add in64 bits before the existing1..255 clamp;preserve default+1 and online/offline updates.
Reject malformed or byte-wrapped guild ranks before the native membership/rank validator.
Validate entry,finite radius,optional spell and WorldSafeLoc together before event-template creation;preserve defaults and native cell-visit radius clamping.
Parse and bind the full native64-bit eventobject DB GUID instead of deleting an aliased32-bit row.
Reject malformed/nonfinite radii and a squared radius outside the native float SQL parameter;retain default10 and finite signed-radius behavior.
Parse the full native world counter and reject bits outside40 before forming a creature GUID;retain the untouched selected-creature/pet/totem/delete flow.
Validate the complete item/count/restock/cost/money tuple before persistence;retain native32-bit fields and64-bit money.
Reject malformed/overflowing vendor-item selectors before the existing vendor-state/removal rules.
Retain the native64-bit spawn GUID and validate the optional signed integer before movement-type persistence. This does not implement the existing unused wait timer.
Validate recipient/text and the full40-bit player counter before lookup/authority/whisper dispatch.
Reject malformed/overflowing entries and propagate the actual temporary-summon result,retaining the native pose/type/lifetime.
Retain64-bit leader/member DB GUIDs in formation storage and diagnostics;reject malformed input before the existing formation-state check.
Keep both native64-bit respawn-link keys,including zero unlink;reject malformed input and retain the native result/validation.
Parse a complete nonzero entry and the actual signed32 respawn value before creation/persistence;retain native negative/zero behavior.
Validate entry and countdown before summoning;reject unsigned values that narrow in the inner signed32 respawn setter and propagate the summon result.
Honor a supplied numeric/link entry instead of ignoring it;retain no-argument selected-object lookup and reject malformed selectors.
Reject malformed path IDs,failed aggregate queries and path/point counter wrap before insertion;preserve selected-path/new-path/first-point behavior.
Parse the complete path ID and retain the native64-bit creature addon GUID before loading the route.
Reject malformed/overflowing path IDs before reloading an unrelated route.
Validate entry/wait before querying and reject failed MAX queries or next-point wrap before script-waypoint insertion.
Reject malformed/overflowing world-quest IDs before generation;retain native nonzero/catalog behavior.
Reject malformed/overflowing item IDs before account transmog deletion;preserve offline-only admission and the native item lookup/transaction.
Reject malformed/overflowing scene selectors before dispatching an unrelated player scene.
Handle a missing selected unit before ToCreature and require an AI before NPC evade;retain named/player authority and hostile-reference cleanup.
Parse the native byte step and check the actual live total including bonus steps before transition;keep native SetCurrentStep diagnostics for other callers.
Validate the criteria enum domain and each32-bit operand before native progression;retain the optional player anchor and ignore-group mode.
Validate the native entry/sentinel domain and signed seat byte before boarding/search;require the real player and retain reverse/self/native entry lookup.
Validate both native32-bit spawn/vehicle IDs before either default summoning or explicit vehicle creation.
Validate native byte roles and every32-bit dungeon selector before one queue request;retain native role/catalog/group admission and set deduplication.
Reject malformed/out-of-range masks without disabling options;retain unsigned32 masks and the-1/no-argument display mode.
Parse a complete signed verbosity value while retaining no-argument display and native nonzero=true behavior.
Apply exploration to the authorized selected player and replace all320 masks so clear actually clears;retain nonzero=true semantics and neighboring fields.
Validate the native unsigned player-cap/signed security selector before mutation or negation;retain named/abbreviated/reset/display modes.
Reject malformed amounts and out-of-array effect indices before the native32-effect lookup;retain native signed amounts,defaults and missing-aura handling.
Reject malformed damage/school operands before native combat effects;preserve nonpositive no-op,authority,alive checks and downstream attribution/scaling.
Validate both item and context IDs before inventory/item-bonus operations;retain native item/context lookup and storage behavior.
Reject aliased item-set IDs and stop safely if native item creation returns null;preserve prior successful grants,self/other binding,notifications and full-bag handling.
